profile.headline: Solution Architect and Application Administrator with a specialty in Planview Portfolios
profile.summary: Technical Analyst with a history of working in the information technology and customer services industries. Skilled in troubleshooting, customer service, and SQL database.  Capable professional with a Bachelor’s Degree with a double-major in Computer Information Systems & Business Administration.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Skills: Planview · SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) · Business Requirements · Workflow Automation

positions.title: Technical Architect
positions.description: I served as the Technical Architect for Planview on the SOA PMO team.  I would collaborate with the project management team to use Planview Portfolios and tailor it to meet business requirements.  My duties later expanded to include Smartsheet development using the dashboards, datamesh/shuttle, and workflow automation.  I worked as administrator for the Planview suite of tools, including Planview Portfolios, AgilePlace, and ProjectPlace.
positions.insights: Skills: Planview · SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) · Business Requirements · Smartsheet · Workflow Automation · database management

positions.title: Sr Applications Developer Analyst
positions.description: As an Application Developer, I would administrate, maintain, and troubleshoot business applications for Honeywell FM&T.  I was the application administrator for Planview Enterprise/Portfolios, Atlassian Jira, Clairvate TIPMS, and DoE’s eDCRO classification software.  I was responsible for serving the Honeywell IT division and resolving internal end user issues.  I would also create/update reports, implement software updates, SQL databases administration, and coordinating server backups and updates.
positions.insights: Skills: Planview · Microsoft SQL Server · SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS) · SQL · Jira · Business Requirements · Project Portfolio Management · Workflow Automation · Custom Reports

positions.title: Sr Technical Solutions Analyst
positions.description:
As a Senior Technical Solution Analyst for the Cerner Clairvia team, I work to provide functional and technical expertise to our clients.  I prioritize and plan issue resolutions both independently and in a collaborative team environment with the goal of incident resolution and application maintenance.  I use my troubleshooting skills to perform investigations of the front-end application and the back-end SQL database by gathering information, using troubleshooting tools, shadowing end users, and testing workflows internally and externally.  I am also responsible for creating and maintaining documentation for team training and to record the results of any ticket investigation and resolution

 •  Awarded Rookie of the Year at the 2018 Cerner Clairvia Town Hall
 •  Won weekly team award 7 out of 16 times for Q1 & Q2 2019, awarded for leading team in number of ticket closes, speed of resolution, and customer satisfaction.
 •  Received Cerner ‘Ping Award’ 3 times in 2017, 9 times in 2018 and 6 times in 2019.  This is can be rewarded monthly for excellent customer survey results. Common comments in my surveys state that I am knowledgeable, patient, courteous, responsive, professional, and an educator.
 •  Received two ‘lifesaver awards’ from other Cerner associates for going above and beyond to assist them with their workload
 •  Presented training sessions for new several Clairvia associates and mentored two new associates
 •  Received government clearance and CAC card as part of Cerner's service agreement with VA

positions.title: Office Support Specialist
positions.description:
As an Office Support Specialist IV at the MU College of Agriculture, Food, and Natural Resources (CAFNR), I processed payroll for staff and student workers, processed reimbursements, and managed the department credit cards.

     As the Graduate Coordinator for Chemical Engineering, I created and maintained Graduate student files and records.  I made department purchases with a personal department purchasing card, and reconciled all department purchases on a monthly basis. Coordinated various student, staff, and alumni meetings, special events, and banquets.  Assisted faculty with various office tasks and answered student questions about the graduate program.

positions.title: Temporary Office Worker
positions.description:
* Processing flexible spending account claims for ASI Flex.
* Providing phone support to customers making claims.

positions.title: Customer Services Specialist I
positions.description:
•	Aid Donor Recruitment Representatives in organizing, promoting, and executing statewide blood drives with over 1200 accounts.
•	Preparation of marketing and promotional materials, such as posters and flyers to promote upcoming donation opportunities
•	Advertise and endorse blood drives electronically, utilizing email blasts and the American Red Cross eDonor website to setup appointments for donors.
•	Foster and maintain a helpful and supportive relationship with blood drive coordinators
•	Organize promotional items and track their shipment to drives to assure timely delivery.

positions.title: Hospital Services Tech I
positions.description:
•	Monitored inventory integrity, tracked shipments, conducted inventory audits, and ordered blood products to anticipate customer’s needs.
•	Kept a customer service dialogue with statewide hospitals to ensure hospitals blood product needs were met in a prompt manner.
•	Maintained clean, safe work equipment that meets or exceeds FDA regulations
